title: Line Chart
description: One series over time, drawn in — the shape of a trend, with the area under it kept quiet.
usage: For a single metric over time. One line, honestly scaled from zero when the values are counts; the end point is marked with the core because the present is the point.
a11y: A chart is a picture of numbers: give the figure role="img" and an aria-label that states the conclusion ("Signups rose from 22 to 71 over the year"), and keep the data available as a table nearby.
